headline: Jaykay Enterprises Limited: Rights Issue Committee Meeting Intimation
sum: Jaykay Enterprises intimated NSE of a Rights Issue Committee meeting scheduled to determine the issue price and other terms of the proposed rights offering.
implication: Rights issue pricing and terms are gated by committee approval before prospectus filing; the intimation signals governance compliance under SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2018 and marks a key procedural checkpoint for capital raise execution.
detail: Jaykay Enterprises Limited filed an NSE intimation disclosing a scheduled meeting of the Rights Issue Committee. The committee is tasked with determining the issue price, subscription period, and other structural terms of the rights offering. This is a mandatory governance step under SEBI regulations before the prospectus can be filed with the stock exchange. The timing and outcome of this meeting will directly influence the offer structure and investor appetite.

framework.ref: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2018
framework.note: Central regulation governing rights issues, pricing mechanisms, disclosure obligations and timeline for listed companies.
Central statute enabling preferential allotment and rights issue; committee must act within statutory mandate.
Applies to committee members and management during price-sensitive period; disclosure of meeting itself may trigger UPSI considerations.

framework.ref: NSE Listing Regulations / BSE Listing Regulations 2015
framework.note: Exchange-level requirements for intimation, timing of announcements, and post-meeting disclosures.
Board and shareholder approval thresholds for capital issuance; rights issue requires prior shareholder authorization.

conditions: Committee approval of issue price and terms
Board and shareholder mandate (likely already obtained)
Prospectus filing with stock exchange post-committee decision
approvals: Rights Issue Committee decision on pricing and terms

triggers.law: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2018
triggers.note: Mandatory committee approval before prospectus filing; pricing and terms must comply with SEBI fair valuation framework.
Rights issue is a statutory form of preferential allotment; requires board authorization within shareholder-approved limits.
Intimation filing itself is a regulatory trigger; subsequent prospectus and allotment notices must follow prescribed timelines.
